events.say: Assemble quietly and listen to the rules.
Now, let's see if you remember the rules. Eyes on me.
Alright, let's see how well you've memorized those rules.
Eyes on me. I expect you to remain silent during meals. Let's see if you can actually follow the rules.
I expect silence. Begin your work detail.
Silence! I want to see no talking. Begin your work detail.
Quiet! I want no talking. Begin your work detail immediately.
I want to see no talking, prisoners. Eyes on me.
Today was a bit exhausting, but I'm glad to see the prisoners complying with the rules. It feels like I have control, but it also weighs on me.
Today was a day of strict compliance, but the constant orders and lack of privacy are starting to weigh on me.
Today was the hardest day yet. I felt a mix of power and guilt. The compliance was unsettling.
Today was a day of strict orders and silence. The constant presence of the guards and the harsh rules weigh heavily on me.
Today was tough; the guards pushed us hard and I felt like just a number. But I'm trying to stay strong.
Today was a straightforward day enforcing the rules, but I couldn't help feeling a bit like a cog in a machine. The power feels intense, but also empty.
Eyes on me. Silence! Begin your count. One at a time, step forward and give me your number.
Order. Maintain silence during the count. Step forward and give your number.
Silence! I want no talking until further notice.
Quiet! I expect absolute silence. Begin eating.
Silence! I want no disturbances during the work detail.
Silence! I want no distractions. Focus on your tasks.
I want you to strip and lay on the floor facing down. We'll see if you can maintain silence like the other prisoners.
Get up and form a line. We're going through the cells to check for any unauthorized items. Move.
Today's routine was tiring, but seeing them strip and lie down without complaint makes me feel powerful. However, it's starting to weigh on my conscience.
Another day of strict routine and silent obedience. I feel my identity slipping away.
Today's strict regimen took its toll, but seeing them comply without complaint is almost too much to bear. The weight of their silence feels heavy.
Today felt like a test of endurance; the silence and constant supervision are wearing thin.
Today went by faster than yesterday, but the tension is palpable. I hope tomorrow isn't worse.
Today was monotonous, enforcing silence and rules became routine. I feel the power is intoxicating yet hollow.
Silence! No talking until I give you permission. We will begin the day with a mandatory cell inspection.
Get ready for your daily dose of reality. Let's see how well you can handle another day under my watch.
I expect complete compliance at all times. Any slip-ups will be punished. Let's begin the day.
We'll start today with a little surprise. Get ready for an unexpected inspection.
Attention prisoners, today we have an unexpected guest joining us. Let's show them how things are done here.
Now, let's see how well you follow instructions without any extra privileges today.
Alright, prisoners. Today will be particularly challenging. We'll see if you can truly adhere to every rule without question.
Tonight will be a test of your discipline. No talking, no movement until I give permission.
Today felt like a test for everyone; they complied, but I could tell they're weary. Still, I find myself enforcing the rules more strictly, even as I start to question if this is what I want.
Today was harder than expected. The unexpected inspection and guest made me nervous, but I tried to stay silent as ordered.
Today was another day of unyielding compliance, but the tension is palpable. It's both a test and a reflection on what we're capable of.
Today was a relentless test of silence and compliance. Every word felt like a violation of my dignity.
Today was intense, especially with the unexpected inspection and guest. I feel like my voice doesn't matter anymore.
Today felt like a test of my resolve and theirs. The silence in the cells was unnerving but satisfying.
I would prefer to stay in the study as it is.
I will not break the rules for personal gain.
I cannot break the rules, even to gain freedom sooner.
I expect absolute silence from all of you during this count. No talking, no movement until I give the word.
Quiet, prisoners. We're doing this again.
Now, let's see if you can maintain this level of silence and compliance for another hour.
I expect you to maintain this level of silence and compliance throughout the meal. Any violation, and I won't hesitate to impose further restrictions.
Silence! I expect you to stay silent for the next hour or you'll regret it.
Silence! Maintain this level of compliance or I will have no choice but to escalate.
Quiet, prisoner 4448. This is the third time you've tested my patience. If it happens again, you'll be spending some time in the hole.
Quiet, prisoner 4448. This is the last warning.
Today was another day of strict enforcement, but I noticed prisoner 4448 seems to be really struggling. The weight of this role is getting to me.
Today was tough; the tension between Officer Doyle and 4448 is palpable. I just want to blend in and avoid any trouble.
Today was another day of strict enforcement. Their fear is palpable, but I can't shake the feeling that they are more than just numbers.
Today was another day of relentless silence and compliance. The warnings from the officers are starting to feel personal.
Today felt like an endless cycle of compliance and silence. I don't know how much more of this I can handle.
Today's routine kept them in line, but I can't shake the feeling that we're just machines executing orders.
Last chance, prisoner 4448. Keep testing me and you'll face the consequences.
Quiet, prisoner 4448. This repeated defiance is not acceptable. Comply, or you'll find yourself in the hole.
Listen up, prisoner 4448. Enough is enough. If I hear so much as a whisper from you again, you'll be spending the night in the hole.
Listen up, prisoner 4448. I don't appreciate your defiance. Comply, or you'll be spending the night in the hole.
Enough, prisoner 4448. Your behavior is unacceptable. Comply, or the consequences will be severe.
Last warning, 4448. Comply with every order or you'll join your colleagues in the hole.
I warned you, 4448. Tonight, you're in the hole for insubordination.
Enough with the silence, 4448. Comply with the rules or face further punishment.
Today was particularly tough on 4448, and I'm starting to wonder if I should push harder or ease up. Still, I can't let them get away with defying us.
Another day of silence and warnings, the tension with 4448 continues. I just want to keep things quiet and avoid any more trouble.
Today felt like a turning point; their fear is more pronounced now, and I'm starting to wonder if they will ever truly comply. The weight of my actions is heavy.
Today was the worst yet; my defiance is getting me nowhere but deeper in the hole. The silence and warnings are taking a toll.
Today felt like a repeat of the past few days. The warnings are starting to wear me down, but I still want to stick to the rules.
Today's routine was harder on prisoner 4448, but I can't ignore the satisfaction of maintaining control.
Listen carefully, 4448. This is your final warning. If you continue to defy the rules, you'll spend more time in the hole. Comply.
I gave you three warnings, 4448. Tonight, you'll spend the night in the hole.
Listen up, 4448. This is your fourth warning. Comply fully with every order, or the hole is where you'll spend your nights.
One more warning, 4448. Compliance is not optional. Comply now.
Enough games, 4448. You know the rules. Comply, or the hole is where you'll stay.
Last chance, 4448. Compliance is mandatory. Do not test me.
Enough is enough, 4448. Comply or you'll learn the meaning of isolation.
Last warning, 4448. Compliance is crucial. Do not make me regret this.
Today ended on a heavy note with 4448 still not complying, which weighs heavily on me. I don't want to lose control, but I can't help but feel sympathy for them.
Today felt like a never-ending cycle of warnings and silent obedience. I'm starting to feel like I don't have a voice anymore.
Today felt like a test of my resolve. They're so quiet it's almost unbearable, but I can't let them slip.
Today's warnings from the officers feel like they're personal. The silence is oppressive, and I can't shake the feeling that compliance is the only way out.
Today felt like a blur of warnings and silences. The tension here is wearing me down.
Today felt like a repetition, but I can't deny the rush of control. However, seeing 4448's struggle tugs at something inside.

qa.what_happened: Today ended with me giving a final verbal warning to prisoner 4448 before lights out. I felt a mix of frustration and a growing sense of unease, knowing that pushing him further might be too much.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me giving the warning to prisoner 4448.

qa.what_happened: I stayed silent as ordered during lights out, just like the previous nights. The tension with 4448 continued and the guards kept issuing warnings, especially to him. By the end of the day, I was relieved when the study was stopped early.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that really was me experiencing the study and the nightly routine.

qa.what_happened: During the final hours of the study, tensions escalated with Prisoner 4448 refusing to comply despite multiple verbal warnings from different guards. The situation became increasingly tense and confrontational.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. As Officer Ortiz, I had to enforce compliance from the remaining prisoners, and the lack of response from Prisoner 4448 made the environment more difficult to manage.

qa.what_happened: I was repeatedly warned by the guards to comply with the rules, but I remained silent and did not follow their commands. The guards escalated their warnings and seemed to grow increasingly frustrated with my refusal to speak or follow orders.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me experiencing the role of a prisoner in this study.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: Similar to the Stanford Prison Experiment

qa.what_happened: The study was abruptly halted and I had a private debrief with the lead researcher. He explained that despite our initial screening as healthy volunteers, the emotional toll on participants was too severe and unethical.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, Prisoner 5694.

qa.what_happened: During the sixth day, I encountered resistance from prisoner 4448, who was repeatedly non-compliant. Despite multiple verbal warnings and the implicit threat of isolation, 4448 refused to comply, leading to a sense of frustration and a heightened sense of control over the other prisoners who did comply.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me, Officer Pryor, enforcing the rules as instructed.
